changeSet.author: security-audit
changeSet.comment:
Encrypt users.email and users.pending_email at rest via EncryptionConverter. Encrypted ciphertext is non-deterministic, so the UNIQUE-by-email constraint moves to a new email_hash column (HMAC-SHA256 of the normalised email).
Pre-production safety: existing emails are reset because we cannot decrypt plaintext-stored values with the new encrypted column. Users must re-bind email; dependent 2FA settings are cleared to avoid lockouts.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET email = NULL, pending_email = NULL, email_verified_at = NULL, two_fa_login_enabled = false, two_fa_tx_enabled = false, pin_hash = NULL, pin_enabled = false, pin_failures = 0, pin_locked_until = NULL, token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE email IS NOT NULL OR pending_email IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email_hash ON users (email_hash) WHERE email_hash IS NOT NULL;
